latin: Qui sciet proprietatem Aquilonis in cabala, sciet cur sathan Christo promisit regna mundi, si cadens eum adorasset.
translation: Whoever knows what the north signifies in the Cabala will know why Satan offered Christ the kingdoms of the world, on condition that he fall down and worship him.
translation_note: 'north' is the standard symbol of the fifth sefirah, one of whose properties is power, and which was regularly associated with Satan and the origin of evil (farmer1998:27408).
